title: Finite coin-run probability
statement: Let $\rho<1$ be real and let $K$ be a nonnegative integer. For each $i\ge 0$, let the $i$th bit be true exactly when the parity of $\lfloor 2^{i+1}\rho\rfloor$ is odd. Choose a length-$K$ Boolean word uniformly at random, and scan it against these bits in order, returning the first scanned bit of the sequence at the first position where the word differs from it. The probability that this returned bit is true is $\lfloor 2^K\rho\rfloor/2^K$.
